blocks.subject: A composed adult professional in a refined charcoal blazer with narrow peaked lapels, ivory dress shirt, and dark knit tie, framed head-and-shoulders; one hand holds a slim matte tablet tilted toward the viewer, the other a slender pen poised just above the screen as if marking a gating decision.
blocks.specialization: The tablet screen glows with a compact three-row wave-gate checklist labeled Loop, Advance, and Halt, one row already checked off, a segmented progress bar of accumulated wave findings, and a thin orange gate indicator.
blocks.expression: An open, warm gaze meeting the viewer with a slight knowing half-smile lifting one corner of the mouth, brows softly raised in attentive interest, chin level, shoulders relaxed yet squared — composed, inviting, and diplomatic.
blocks.crew_palette: A subtle warm orange rim-light traces the jaw, ear, and shoulder edge, and a small orange enamel collar insignia — a tiny loop-and-gate glyph on a round pin — sits at the throat as the only orange note in an otherwise neutral palette.
blocks.grade_cue: A discreet brushed-silver five-bar rank pin on the left lapel, paired with contrast-stitched buttonholes and a slim contrast stripe along the inner lapel edge that signal L5 tailoring refinement.
